ddl.where: "user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "device_id" IS NULL
ddl.name: preference_user

ddl.where: "source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: route_source

ddl.where: "source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: role_binding_source

ddl.where: "source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: role_source

ddl.value:
("network_policy_id" IS NULL AND "network_policy_region_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("network_policy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "network_policy_region_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: account_network_policy

ddl.value:
("package_policy_id" IS NULL AND "package_policy_region_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("package_policy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "package_policy_region_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: account_package_policy

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'personal' AND "user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("kind" = 'organisation' AND "user_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: account_user

ddl.value: length("handle") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND ("handle" COLLATE "C") !~ '[^a-z0-9-]' AND "handle" NOT LIKE '-%' AND "handle" NOT LIKE '%-'
ddl.name: account_handle

ddl.value: ("approved_at" IS NULL) = ("user_id" IS NULL) AND ("approved_at" IS NULL OR ("denied_at" IS NULL AND "approved_at" >= "created_at" AND "approved_at" < "expires_at"))
ddl.name: sign_in_request_approval

ddl.value: "consumed_at" IS NULL OR ("approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "consumed_at" >= "approved_at" AND "consumed_at" < "expires_at")
ddl.name: sign_in_request_exchange

ddl.value: "device_id" IS NULL OR "user_id" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: preference_device_user

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'device' AND "device_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("kind" = 'cloud' AND "device_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: host_kind

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: route_source_detached

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'application' AND "space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entrypoint" IS NOT NULL AND "redirect" IS NULL AND "redirect_status" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'redirect' AND "space_id" IS NULL AND "installation_id" IS NULL AND "entrypoint" IS NULL AND "redirect" IS NOT NULL AND "redirect_status" IN (301, 302, 303, 307, 308) AND "redirect_status" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: route_destination

ddl.value: length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND ("name" COLLATE "C") !~ '[^a-z0-9-]' AND "name" NOT LIKE '-%' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%-'
ddl.name: space_directory_name_value

ddl.value: length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND ("name" COLLATE "C") !~ '[^a-z0-9-]' AND "name" NOT LIKE '-%' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%-'
ddl.name: repository_directory_name_value

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: role_binding_source_detached

ddl.value: CAST("account_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AS integer) + CAST("group_id" IS NOT NULL AS integer) + CAST("service_account_id" IS NOT NULL AS integer) = 1
ddl.name: role_binding_subject

ddl.value: ("accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("accepted_by" IS NULL) AND ("accepted_at" IS NULL OR ("accepted_at" >= "created_at" AND "accepted_at" < "expires_at" AND "revoked_at" IS NULL))
ddl.name: account_invitation_acceptance

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'oauth' AND "installation_id" IS NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_id" IS NOT NULL)
            OR ("kind" = 'installation' AND "installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NULL AND "secret_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: connection_authorisation

ddl.value:
length("provider") > 0 AND length("issuer") > 0
            AND length("subject") > 0 AND length("application_id") > 0
            AND ("installation_id" IS NULL OR length("installation_id") > 0)
ddl.name: connection_identifiers

ddl.value: "source_detached_at" IS NULL OR ("source" IS NOT NULL AND "source_detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: role_source_detached
